WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag sp, f.sale_date, d.format, d.store_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d USING(store_key)
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) nret, sum(quantity_returned) q, sum(refund_net) refund, min(return_date) mind, max(return_date) maxd FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.format, s.sp, count(*) lines, sum(s.net_amount) sold, sum(r.refund) refunded, 100*sum(r.refund)/sum(s.net_amount) pct_val, 100.0*sum(r.q)/sum(s.quantity) pct_units,
 max(r.nret) maxret, max(r.maxd) lastret, sum(CASE WHEN r.refund>s.net_amount+0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund, sum(CASE WHEN r.mind<s.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.format, count(*) n,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned=f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) full_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_net - f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) not_prorata,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned>f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_over,

WITH sold AS (

  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key

    AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND d.store_id < 900),
ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)

  round(100 * coalesce(sum(ret.refund_net), 0) / sum(sold.net_amount), 2) AS returned_share_pct
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY sold.format ORDER BY sold.format
